analysis.cost: Report actual completed depth, candidate and foe nodes/qnodes/caller seconds, fallback/source, and paired candidate node deltas. Treat wall-clock as descriptive only under concurrent load.
analysis.primary: Pair static-minus-Unit candidate reward by exact generated root and candidate owner against the same fixed Unit foe. Each UNKNOWN independently contributes [-1,+1] before conservative subtraction.
analysis.retain_rule: Retain this sampled-scope ordering candidate only if either (a) conservative utility lower bounds are strictly positive overall, by owner, by root parity and for every leave-one-seed-out view, or (b) median paired candidate-node use falls by at least 10% overall and in both owner and parity strata, while no corresponding stratum has a negative conservative utility lower bound. Otherwise close this capture-order route for this sample. Neither outcome changes a default/global value or strength claim.
analysis.robustness: Report all-slot bounds overall, by candidate owner, 3/4-ply root parity and leave-one-rule-seed-out; preserve candidate-first/reply and each seed. No winner/draw imputation.

arms.candidate_only_change: Both candidate arms set use_staged_move_picker=True. The controlled evaluator preserves identical Unit board/hand leaf values and identical Unit type_value promotion ordering; only capture_order_value changes from the Unit board table to the current rule-derived static-v2 profile. The candidate path is explicitly experimental and is not the SearchTuning default.
arms.fixed_foe: Unit leaf, Unit capture-order and Unit type-order values in both arms; same public AlphaBeta path, optional staged picker and limits.
arms.physical_games: 8 generated rules x 2 roots x 2 candidate owners x 2 candidate arms = 64

changed_premise: The preceding default MoveOrderer capture-order panel is closed and does not exercise StagedMovePicker. A new outcome-free preflight on eight disjoint generated-rule seeds and 16 fixed legal roots exercised the staged picker: 146 root capture-hook calls, 11 changed root orders, seven changed root search actions, and 7,472 Unit versus 8,148 static candidate-search hook calls. This exposure result is not utility evidence.

cost.basis: Prior 64-game D3/8192/0.5-second game generation took 171.657 seconds including full records/replay. Estimate 600 seconds for staged ordering plus validation, capped at 3600 seconds; the run stays under 120 minutes.
cost.cheaper_alternative: Close staged capture-order utility as unresolved after the outcome-free preflight and retain the optional path unchanged.

integrity: Run all 64 slots once; no outcome-based filtering, top-up, replacement, cap extension or rerun of an observed slot.
Preserve promotion, drops, hands, auxiliary state, repetition and complete Core history; validate action legality and replay every full history.
Retain UNKNOWN for horizon or unresolved search; distinguish actual terminals, cancellations, fallbacks and incomplete slots.
No training, solver, production source/default changes or other-role checkout access.

Expected run 600 seconds based on a prior same-scale 64-game D3/8192/0.5-second public AlphaBeta panel completing in 171.657 seconds; allow 3x for staged-picker and replay overhead. Frozen hard cap 3600 seconds, below 120-minute assessment threshold.
question: On fresh generated 5x5 legal roots, does static-v2 capture_order_value improve finite-budget candidate outcomes or robust candidate-node cost when the actual optional StagedMovePicker path is enabled for both arms, leaf values and Unit foe are fixed?

roots.selection: Use all 16 roots exactly as fixed by the hash-bound outcome-free preflight; never filter or replace by actions, captures, exposure, outcome, profile, cost or terminality. If an unexpected terminal/root mismatch occurs, preserve it and stop the panel without replacement.
